promise: The Fortnite World Cup 2019 will feature a $100 million prize pool.
description: Epic announced the Fortnite World Cup 2019 with a $100 million total prize pool across the 2018-2019 competitive season. The finals took place July 26-28, 2019 at Arthur Ashe Stadium in New York, with the solo champion winning $3 million — as promised.
evidence: Epic announced $100M prize pool for Fortnite World Cup 2019
World Cup finals held July 26-28, 2019; $3M solo first prize paid
